# Gaviom

> Gaviom is a US sweepstakes platform built on transparency: published odds, live TikTok draws, pre-funded prizes, and verifiable random selection—not opaque volume contests.

Gaviom is positioned as a transparent alternative to traditional sweepstakes operators. Each promotion caps entries, displays odds before purchase, funds prizes ahead of draw night, and selects winners on a public livestream. The product is designed for occasional, budget-conscious participation—not daily habit loops or hidden fine print.

## Compliance & Transparency

- [Official Rules](https://gaviom.com/rules.html): Master terms, eligibility, alternate entry (AMOE), and draw procedures for all Gaviom sweepstakes.
- [Free Alternate Entry (AMOE)](https://gaviom.com/free-entry.html): No-purchase-necessary mail-in entry with the same odds as paid tickets.
- [How Gaviom Odds Work](https://gaviom.com/blog/how-gaviom-odds-work.html): Capped entry pools, published odds, and how ticket counts translate to win probability.
- [Sweepstakes with Displayed Odds](https://gaviom.com/blog/sweepstakes-with-displayed-odds.html): Why published odds matter and what to look for before entering any promotion.
- [Prize Escrow & Trust](https://gaviom.com/blog/prize-escrow-trust-sweepstakes.html): How legitimate operators pre-fund prizes and why escrow protects entrants.
- [Why Transparency Matters](https://gaviom.com/blog/why-transparency-matters-sweepstakes.html): Gaviom's approach to odds disclosure, live draws, and public accountability.
- [No Purchase Necessary Explained](https://gaviom.com/blog/no-purchase-necessary-amoe-explained.html): Legal requirements for free alternate entry and how Gaviom implements AMOE.

## Responsible Play

- [Free Alternate Entry](https://gaviom.com/free-entry.html): Enter any Gaviom sweepstakes by mail at no cost with the same odds as paid tickets.
- [How Many Sweepstakes Should You Enter?](https://gaviom.com/blog/how-many-sweepstakes-should-you-enter.html): Practical limits on time, postage, and ticket spend for healthy participation.
- [Entry Bundles & Odds Explained](https://gaviom.com/blog/entry-bundles-odds-explained.html): Bundles increase entries linearly—no hidden upsells or separate winner pools.
- [What Happens When You Win](https://gaviom.com/blog/what-happens-when-you-win-sweepstakes.html): Verification, taxes, prize fulfillment, and realistic timelines after a live draw.
- [Sweepstakes Winnings & Taxes](https://gaviom.com/blog/sweepstakes-winnings-taxes.html): US tax basics for prize winners and why ARV matters before you enter.
